name: Flights
author: Reynke De Vos
description: Track a dated multi-leg trip in the bar: live status icons, transfer time, a leave-for-pickup time, and milestone notifications.

barWidget.description: Track a dated multi-leg journey with live progress and arrival notifications.

schema.label: Dated flight legs
schema.description: Comma-separated flight@date values, for example LH400@2026-12-23,LH2054@2026-12-24.

schema.label: Home timezone
schema.description: IANA timezone used for your landing clock, for example Europe/Berlin.

schema.label: Leave before landing
schema.description: Minutes before the final landing that you need to leave home for pickup.

schema.label: Journey notifications
schema.description: Notify for departure, delays, gate changes, landing proximity, transfer, leave-for-pickup reminders, and arrival.
